heldReview: Deloitte USI Quality Engineer 368242, Dot Net Developer Analyst 351582 and ML/AI Data Science Engineer II 350771 returned blocked exact-page responses at final verification; held as REVIEW, not Expired.

discoverySummary.note: Fresh 23 Oct discovery. Historical jobs, current and archived review batches, queued records and Telegram deliveries were checked. One employer per combined Priority and Backup set. Only exact Live and source-complete candidates were persisted so the Android review-notification gate can evaluate the batch.

ranking.policy: Zero-experience eligibility, exact current application evidence, Deloitte/watchlist priority, usefulness and source completeness; one employer per combined batch.
